sentence: This project builds a mass spectrometer that studies the structures of weakly-bound complexes and how their molecules interact.
This project develops lab exercises and an open platform for learning how to watermark content made by AI.
This project builds a computer tool that predicts how a silicone material cures when 3D printing microfluidic devices with a laser.
This project studies singularities, which are points on a curve or surface that are not smooth, using homological methods.
This project builds a solver that tests whether a mix of equations and logical rules can hold at once, using methods from neural-network verification.
This project studies how protein phosphorylation affects which mitochondrial proteins are turned over when cells break down whole mitochondria.
This project develops methods that help teams of robots, drones and sensors cover a space, using ideas from statistics and machine learning.
This project builds a secondary ion mass spectrometer that uses multicharged ions from a laser to analyze the surface of solid materials.
This project builds intelligent security agents that learn and work with human experts to detect threats and protect computer networks.
This project builds computer models that learn from video how people move and handle objects in ways that follow physics.
This project develops methods that find which variables cause which others in complex systems and measure how certain those answers are.
This project designs particle dampers placed around a nuclear reactor to keep seismic waves from passing through.
This project brings together experts to discuss how nanotechnology can make computing and sensing use less energy.
This project develops machine learning methods for wireless systems whose hardware distorts signals in nonlinear ways.
This project builds an AI tool that uses military language and examples to explain engineering ideas to veterans and service members.
This project studies how to design robots automatically by tracing errors, the way artificial neural networks are improved.
This project builds methods that run on portable devices to detect antimicrobial resistance in a biological sample in real time.
This project studies how swapping the sulfur in nanoparticles of copper and sulfur for selenium or tellurium changes the particles.
